notes.title: Vestaria Saga II: The Sacred Sword of Silvanister Announced for Steam!
notes.notes:
Hello Vestaria Saga fans!

We are pleased to announce [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811600/Vestaria_Saga_II_The_Sacred_Sword_of_Silvanister/]Vestaria Saga II: The Sacred Sword of Silvanister![/url] Coming to Steam in 2022!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811600/Vestaria_Saga_II_The_Sacred_Sword_of_Silvanister/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33424841/fc06f589fceff44a3cd4aa05b65ecfd69a98c3a9.gif[/img][/url]

While Vestaria Saga I chronicled the battles that ensued in the Solvian-Meledian War, Vestaria Saga II focuses on the further adventures of Zade, the hero from VS1, bringing the tales of him and his companions to a thrilling, satisfying end. Across his epic quest, Zade will encounter allies both new and old while also uncovering more of the mysteries behind the vile Margulites and their plan to plunge Vestaria into a new age of darkness.

We hope you look forward to continuing the saga in 2022! Wishlist today!

notes.title: 《维斯塔利亚传说》常见问题解决方法汇总
notes.notes:
Q：[b]如何全屏游玩？[/b]
A： 按F4可以全屏，但全屏后会看不见鼠标光标，因此全屏后最好用键盘（z确定x取消）或手柄操作。

Q：[b]如何调整音量等设置？[/b]
A：调整音量等设置的话要在战斗中点击地图上的空地，在呼出的菜单中选择“环境”进行调整。

Q：[b]怎么设置中文？[/b]
A：在你的Steam库中找到《维斯塔利亚传说 亡国骑士与星辰巫女》，右键选择属性，在语言一栏中切换至“简体中文”，启动程序。

Q：[b]手柄摇杆只能左上操作或手柄无法操作。[/b]
A：打开steam页面，点开最左上角的“steam”，然后选择“设置”，在设置页面点击“控制器”，在控制器页面选择“常规控制器设置”，然后在弹出的页面中把所有的√给取消掉就可以了。

notes.title: Vestaria Saga I Soundtrack PIANO ARRANGEMENT & 8-BIT MUSIC VERSION is complete!
notes.notes:
Dear Vestaria Saga fans,

Thank you very much for your patience! We are pleased to announce that the Vestaria Saga I Soundtrack PIANO ARRANGEMENT & 8-BIT MUSIC VERSION is now complete and available in full for Steam!

Not only that, but the complete version includes more tracks than originally planned! The album now consists of seven brand-new piano arrangements (2 more than planned), seventeen 8-bit versions (6 more than planned) and seven original tracks, for a total of 31 tracks! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1216180/Vestaria_Saga_I_Soundtrack_PIANO_ARRANGEMENT__8BIT_MUSIC_VERSION/

Furthermore, the format of the album has been changed from "DLC" to "Soundtrack," which means the album can be purchased independently from the game. If you have already purchased the album via DLC, you now have access to the full album. In order to access it, please follow these steps:

Open Vestaria Saga in your Steam Library
Find the album under 'Additional Content' on the right of the landing page and click it
Click the 'Download Album' button on the details screen
Choose the download location of your choice (the default directory is Program Files (x86)/Steam/steamapps/music/ )

We hope you all enjoy the this new, exclusive album by Hiroto Saitoh!

notes.title: Wot I think Vestaria Saga I: War of the Scions
notes.notes:
Developer: Vestaria Project
Publisher: DANGEN Entertainment, Gamera Game

Release: Out now
On: Windows
From: Steam
Price: 15.50/$20/ 17

Look, do you like Fire Emblem? If so, do you believe the series peaked with the release of Thracia 776, twenty years ago? Well, if that’s you, then great. You’re gonna adore Vestaria Saga I: War of the Scions. On the other hand, if you’ve never played a tactical RPG of this broad type (think Disgaea or Banner Saga) before, it might be wiser to back away. This is a game for, and by, hardcore Fire Emblem fans, made by series creator Shouzo Kaga and a small team of dedicated followers.

What if you’re somewhere in the middle? Well. More general tactics game enthusiasts will find plenty to love here – but they’ll have to be prepared to get accustomed to some typical Fire Emblem idiosyncrasies which Vestaria never bothers to explain.
